title: Colli Berici easy + hill strides
terrain: Brendola, Colli Berici, rolling road or trail, ~150m D+
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 45min rolling at 138-152bpm, ~150m D+. Then 6x30s strong uphill, 180+ spm, walk down 1min. 5min easy. Done by 08:45, before work.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water. Dinner by 20:30, lights out 23:00 (Sat is the key day).
GARMIN: ~60-75.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or sleep under 6h = 35min easy, no strides.
WHY: +15 vs the old 35 recovers part of Monday's dropped load on the one day that cannot hurt Saturday.
